## Job and drawing review

- Delete jobs from the dashboard with confirmation; original files outside the
  job folder are retained.
- Move the drawing review note out of the way, and mark a component's location
  directly on a drawing. User-marked locations are retained on regeneration
  when the drawing and material identity are unchanged.
- Highlighted linework is presented for identification rather than assumed to be
  piping. Fractional and reducing sizes are preserved in scope material labels.

## BOM and change takeoff

- Bring the material list to the front of the exported PDF, and retain only the
  latest successfully generated BOM files for a job.
- Preserve separate scope work areas and leave unstated material quantities blank.
  Matching demo and new-work tag labels can be reviewed on the drawing.
- A printed drawing BOM remains a master list, not proof that each item is in
  scope. Printed BOM scans do not automatically compare demo and new-work tags.
  Tag labels, nearby references, and table rows are not necessarily component
  locations. Verify locations, quantities, connections, and ancillary materials
  against the drawings and specifications before procurement.

Windows and macOS builds include local Tesseract OCR. AI review remains optional.
